purpose: Creative direction defaults for avatar-led campaigns. These are brand rules, not identity facts about INA or SIS.
coreAesthetic: Y2K-adjacent attitude used selectively rather than as costume

surrealismPolicy.rule: Surreal or bizarre elements may support the concept but must not obscure the sisters, the product, or campaign readability.

backgroundDirections: unexpected oversized jewelry or piercing-inspired objects when conceptually useful
compositionPreferences: one memorable strange idea rather than many competing gimmicks
avoid: generic white-background ecommerce stiffness when a campaign visual is requested
visual clutter that hides the product
random surrealism with no relationship to the campaign idea
